shortDescription: Manages snapshots in units of snapshot groups on VSP block storage systems.

options.name: connection_info
options.description: Information required to establish a connection to the storage system.

options.name: spec
options.description: Specification for the snapshot group tasks.

options.name: state
options.description: The level of the snapshot task. Choices are C(absent), C(split), C(sync), C(restore), C(clone), C(defragment).

options.name: storage_system_info
options.description: Information about the storage system. This field is an optional field.
